summary: STORE-012C CLIENT PORTAL CONCEPT REVIEW™ fully verified — Backend 13/13 pytest PASS, Frontend Client Review page e2e PASS via playwright. Share endpoint marks the 3 boards of the set as status='sent' + stamps shared_at/shared_by + emits concept_set_shared timeline event; notify=false suppresses email; notify=true with no client_user_id returns email.sent=false (reason='no_client_email') and the endpoint still succeeds. Unshare reverts status to 'draft' and clears shared_at/shared_by. GET /api/client/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions returns ONLY shared sets, never exposes client_alignment_score (verified by string scan of full JSON payload), every direction includes moodboard_id/direction_letter/direction_name/color_palette/style_dna_snapshot/material_entity_ids/media_ids/cover_url/designer_notes/is_preferred/my_reactions[]. Feedback endpoint: interested → narrative italiano 'Il cliente ha segnato "X" come interessante.'; preferred → is_preferred=true on this board AND unset on the prior preferred board in same set; switching preferred A→B emits 'cambiato direzione preferita: da "A" a "B"'; comment requires non-empty body (422 otherwise); invalid reaction → 422. CRITICAL INVARIANT verified: moodboard.status NEVER changes from client feedback (stays 'sent', never 'approved'). Client Alignment Score™ increments correctly internally (3/2/10/5) and is stored on the studio-side moodboard ai_metadata.concept_seed.client_alignment_score — never leaks to /api/client/* responses. tenant_admin/super_admin QA bypass on _require_client confirmed working (admin user successfully drives the entire flow). Frontend Client page renders 12 cards across 4 sets with palette swatches, Style DNA list, 4 action buttons; gold ribbon + amber border on preferred card; reaction history pills surfacing; Italian toast narratives; Comment modal opens/submits/dismisses.

critical_code_review_comments: client_portal.py 1118 LOC — borderline (>700 target). Concept Review block (lines 860-1118) is cohesive and easily extractable into a separate router file (e.g. routers/client_concept_review.py) to keep client_portal.py lean. Suggest splitting before next feature lands here.

Locale resolver imported via local `from routers.concept_directions import _resolve_client_locale` inside the feedback handler — acceptable but creates an implicit cross-router dependency; consider moving the resolver into a shared `services/locales.py` for reuse.

concept_seed updates use a read→mutate→write pattern without optimistic locking. Two concurrent client feedback POSTs on the SAME moodboard can race and one client_reaction can be lost. Low-probability for the client portal, but worth a comment or an updated_at compare-and-swap if traffic grows.
Reaction model VALID_REACTIONS / SCORE_WEIGHT / FB_NARRATIVES are duplicated as dicts in module scope — clean but consider a single source-of-truth dataclass / Enum for type safety.

Email send path swallows all exceptions and returns reason=str(e)[:120] — good for non-blocking UX, but means a misconfigured SMTP would still report email.sent=false with a possibly noisy reason. Consider tagging known reasons ('no_client_email', 'no_client_user_id', 'smtp_error') discretely so the UI can render a helpful state.

_require_client tenant_admin/super_admin bypass works for QA but be careful: in production an admin can read+post feedback as if they were any client. Acceptable while flagged 'QA bypass' but should be gated by an env flag (e.g. ALLOW_ADMIN_CLIENT_BYPASS) before going prod.

Frontend: ClientConceptReviewPage card history pills are not optimistically updated after a successful action — calling fetchData() after each action would fix the cosmetic gap (already happens, but state diff may render only on next animation frame).

Studio summary view dbe-share / dbe-shared pill / preferred star / reaction strip — visually confirmed via prior iter217 smoke (gated behind SummaryView reachability per iter217 open item); no regression detected in backend wiring.

Test journey 8bb7a3b4-... now carries 9+ direction sets (each test run appends 3-5 more). Consider a cleanup endpoint (DELETE /api/journeys/{jid}/concept-directions/{set_id}) for QA hygiene; otherwise the journey will accumulate dozens of sets over time.

rca_of_issue: No production bugs found. The only minor UX gap is the history-pill optimistic update: when the client triggers their FIRST reaction on a card, the local state update happens but the conditional render `{d.my_reactions?.length > 0 && <div data-testid=ccr-history-{id}>}` does not pick up the new reaction until the next fetchData() resolves. Mitigation: append the new reaction to the in-memory direction.my_reactions array on optimistic success before the refetch completes, or invalidate/refetch synchronously after POST 201.
